subject.title: perf(ui): trust startup metadata and damp catalog polling

question: Should this protected Control UI performance change be approved after a maintainer verifies metadata-fallback completeness and the intentional foreground-refresh latency tradeoff?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the available evidence does not independently demonstrate the claimed live behavior.

options.title: Review with runtime evidence
options.body: Confirm the startup metadata fallback cases and inspect a redacted after-fix request trace before accepting the polling reduction.

options.title: Request a narrower proof update
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal, network, or runtime-log evidence that shows the eliminated metadata request and stable catalog cadence under live activity.

recommendation.title: Review with runtime evidence
recommendation.body: Confirm the startup metadata fallback cases and inspect a redacted after-fix request trace before accepting the polling reduction.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the proposed UI and Gateway changes and is the only concrete area contact present in the supplied review context.
